career_ladder.note: Promotions in the Executive Cadre of Andaman & Nicobar Police are governed by the Andaman and Nicobar Police (Recruitment) Rules for Group 'C' posts (published vide Extraordinary Gazette No. 143 dated 20/12/2022) and Group 'B' Non-Gazetted posts (published vide Extraordinary Gazette dated 20/12/2022). Entry is at Constable (Pay Level 3), advancing to Head Constable (Pay Level 4), Assistant Sub-Inspector (Pay Level 5), Sub-Inspector (Pay Level 6), and Inspector (Pay Level 7). Higher progression leads to Deputy Superintendent of Police (Level 10) under the Delhi, Andaman and Nicobar Islands Police Service (DANIPS) Cadre Rules.

exam_scheme.note: The recruitment process is prescribed in Direct Recruitment Notice No. A-12024/1/2024-RECRUITMENTCELLPHQ-POLICE_AN/284 dated 24/04/2026 and Corrigendum No. DGP/RC/DR/2026/139/534 dated 27/07/2026. Stage 1 is the Physical Measurement & Endurance Test (PM&ET), which is strictly qualifying in nature and mandatory for all candidates. Candidates qualifying in PM&ET appear for Stage 2, a 200-mark written test of Higher Secondary Level standard. Merit is drawn purely on written examination marks, subject to medical examination and character verification.

financial_package.note: Andaman & Nicobar Islands is a Union Territory directly administered by the Central Government (Ministry of Home Affairs); police personnel are Central Civil Services employees governed under the Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix. In addition to 58% Central DA and standard HRA/Transport Allowance, personnel serving in the islands are entitled to Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) under Ministry of Finance orders ranging from 10% (Port Blair / South Andaman) up to 20% (difficult / remote Nicobar group of islands).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Andaman & Nicobar Police — Direct Recruitment Notice No. A-12024/1/2024-RECRUITMENTCELLPHQ-POLICE_AN/284 dated 24/04/2026 (Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level 3, ₹21,700 - ₹69,100)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Central 7th CPC Level 3 Entry Basic Pay of ₹21,700 with DA at 58% (₹12,586). Includes HRA (9% / ₹1,953 in non-metro / island towns, or government quarter allotment), Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + DA ₹783 = ₹2,133), Ration Money / Diet Allowance (~₹3,000-₹3,500), and Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) at 10% (₹2,170) to 20% (₹4,340) of Basic Pay depending on posting zone. Deductions include NPS employee contribution (10% of Basic + DA = ₹3,429) and CGEGIS/insurance, yielding estimated in-hand pay of ₹34,000 to ₹39,500.
official_perks: Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) of 10% to 20% of Basic Pay depending on posting difficulty zone
Ration Money Allowance / Diet Allowance for executive police personnel
Uniform Allowance and kit maintenance allowance
Government departmental quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Central Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme (CGEGIS) and Central Civil Services medical reimbursement
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) including sea/air passage between mainland India and Andaman & Nicobar Islands per GOI rules
Defined contribution pension under the National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Central Government contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: Applicant figures, PM&ET schedules, and vacancy numbers are sourced directly from Andaman & Nicobar Police recruitment orders and published candidate master lists. In the 2026 mega-recruitment cycle, a combined recruitment across Group 'B' and Group 'C' posts advertised 155 vacancies for Constable (Executive) and 40 vacancies for Constable (GD - IRBn) (total 195 Constable vacancies). The published PM&ET master schedule dated 07/09/2026 confirmed 22,294 scheduled candidates across all notified posts, of which 18,693 opted for Constable (Executive) and 12,414 opted for Constable (GD - IRBn). In the 2017 cycle, 60 vacancies were notified for Constable (Executive). In 2016, 10,386 eligible candidates were scheduled for PM&ET at Netaji Stadium, Port Blair.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 114 (calculated: total scheduled applicants 22,294 ÷ 195 constable vacancies)
